finding: The probability-domain compatibility loss clamped foreground probability to [1e-6,1-1e-6]. On a severely missing foreground ray, the V3 signed-field logit was below -50 and sigmoid probability was below the clamp floor, so the clamp derivative was zero and the dense objective produced exactly zero signed-field gradient on the most severe error.
secondary_failure: The actual SceneFirstSignedGeometryV3 end-to-end gradient witness also reached sdf_head with zero norm because the same probability clamp saturated its sampled rays.

scientific_disposition.corrective_change: Compute foreground_logit=-hard_amin(sdf)/beta and apply binary_cross_entropy_with_logits directly. Use sigmoid(logit) only for the soft-Dice term and diagnostics.
scientific_disposition.reason: BCEWithLogits preserves the analytic gradient for large-magnitude wrong logits without probability clipping and is numerically stable.

required_retest: severely missing foreground ray has finite nonzero signed-field gradient with the corrective sign
FORK_GAP and CONCAVE_NOTCH negative-space rays retain corrective background gradient
end-to-end loss backpropagates through the actual V3 signed-field sdf_head with finite nonzero norm
all prior primitive and phase/component tests remain green
